---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FISCAL physical parts (Phase 011): purses and the payment and collection actions
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FISCAL_PURSES: a purse is a container of coin that the world opens at founding, attached to the town. It
is held by an office or job (`holder_role`): the clerk-treasurer keeps the treasury, the pastor keeps the
church funds. A purse keeps a ledger of what it recorded in and out (`recorded`), so its coin and its books
can be compared. `opening_coin` is 0: the seeds give no opening figure (APPROX, an empty purse at founding).

FISCAL_ACTIONS: the physical checks each action makes. A payment or collection moves whole coins
(round_bp in domains/world_affordances.py does the arithmetic that needs rounding). The actions do not decide:
whether to pay, how much a rate is, whom to collect from, or whether to deliver. A refused attempt names a
physical reason; a payer short of coin at the payee's cell records one missed period as arrears.
Descriptions are for the LLM prompt and the self-test.

treasury.title: the council's treasury
treasury.description: Coin the council holds for public payroll and receives from tax. The clerk-treasurer holds it and keeps its ledger.

church_funds.title: the church funds
church_funds.description: Coin the church holds from tithes and donations, for the pastor's stipend and charity. The pastor holds it.

assess_obligation.description: Record that one party owes another a fixed amount, or round_bp(base, rate_bp) of a base, per period under a fiscal institution. The rate and amount are chosen by an agent; the world records them and checks only that the parties exist and the numbers are whole coins.
checks: debtor and creditor exist (a resident or a purse; not two purses; not the same party)
amount or base and rate are whole coins, rate in 0..10000
a hired collector is a resident, not the debtor, and only for a resident debtor
assess_obligation.record: an Obligation node: institution, debtor, creditor, amount, base, rate_bp, collector, and counters for paid, arrears, held, delivered, skimmed

pay_obligation.description: Hand one period's amount of an obligation to its creditor (or into a purse), face to face. The payer is the debtor, or for a purse debtor its holder; the receiver is the creditor, or for a purse creditor its holder.
checks: the acting resident is the debtor (or the purse holder for a purse debtor)
the receiver is the creditor (or the purse holder for a purse creditor)
acting resident and receiver stand on the same cell
pay_obligation.on_short: when the paying side has less coin than the amount, no coin moves and one period is recorded as arrears
pay_obligation.record: coin moves between the two sides; the obligation's paid and periods_paid rise; a Handover is recorded; a purse's recorded ledger moves with the coin

collect.description: Collect one period of an obligation from its debtor, who must be on the collector's cell. The collector may be the creditor, a hired collector named on the obligation, or the holder of a purse creditor.
checks: the debtor is a resident on the collector's cell
the collector is the creditor, the named hired collector, or the purse holder for a purse creditor
collect.on_short: when the debtor has less coin than the amount, no coin moves and one period is recorded as arrears; a debtor on another cell is not reached and nothing is recorded
collect.record: coin moves to the creditor, or to the hired collector's own coin as held (owed on to the creditor); paid and periods_paid rise

deliver_collected.description: A hired collector hands on the coin held for the creditor, a share of it in basis points. The collector keeps the rest, which is recorded as skimmed.
checks: the acting resident is the hired collector named on the obligation
the collector has the coin to deliver
the collector stands on the same cell as the creditor (or the creditor's purse holder)
deliver_collected.record: the delivered share moves from the collector's coin to the creditor; held is cleared; delivered and skimmed are recorded
